plaatsen.tekst: She is more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared
For wisdom is better than rubies; and all the things that may be desired are not to be compared
There is gold, and a multitude of rubies: but the lips of knowledge are a precious jewel.
Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing was of sapphire:
